svg.title: Our British Columbia — BC Pavilion Expo 86 film poster
svg.desc: Clean reconstruction from the supplied photographed poster. Native editable shapes; custom constructed title letterforms; open-font billing outlines; PofBC 12-path flag reused for the Pavilion badge. Working aspect ratio is approximate. Photography holders, curl, reflections and ageing are excluded. Some occluded fine-print words are editorial expansions documented on their individual groups and in the accompanying report.

g.ns0:title: Industrial Showmanship — reconstructed production emblem
g.ns0:desc: Manually constructed gear, wing feathers, movie camera and tripod. Typography outlined from Stardos Stencil Bold as a disclosed type substitute. Evidence: eBay poster detail i.ebayimg.com/images/g/YIEAAeSwWLhplo8j/s-l1600.webp. Approximation of the historic linework, no tracing or embedded image.

g.ns0:title: Bob Rogers & Company, Inc. — reconstructed production mark
g.ns0:desc: Manually composed filmstrip and outlined Alfa Slab One typography, optically spaced to poster detail. Historical face unconfirmed. Evidence: eBay detail i.ebayimg.com/images/g/YIEAAeSwWLhplo8j/s-l1600.webp. No embedded image or tracing.

g.ns0:title: The British Columbia Pavilion Expo 86 — reconstructed badge
g.ns0:desc: Reconstructed Pavilion badge: twelve native PofBC flag path geometries reused with poster colours; shared custom title letterforms; constructed frame and outlined caption typography. No embedded raster image.
